buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (PQC)

The bidders shall upload following pre-qualification documents along with their offer as per mentioned in P ART-I of e-tender: Pre-qualification Criteria: 1) Past Work Experience: The bidder should have experience of having successfully completed / executed “similar type of job or tran sportation of Machinery and allied items / Drums in industries”, in last seven years ending last day of mont h previous to the one in which applications are invited and should be fulfilling either of the following: a. One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.11.85 Lakhs OR b. Two similar completed works each costing not less than amount equal to Rs.7.40 Lakhs OR c. Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.5.92 Lakhs. Note: � Copy of the Purchase Order (PO) / Work Order / Contract for the supply of similar items / works /services shall be issued and executed within the last seven (7) years. � All values mentioned above shall be compared with basic work done value (i.e. value excluding of taxes) of Work Orders. � Following documents shall be required to demonstrate experience in completion of similar items / works / services- (i) Completion Certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate OR (ii) GeM SDAC (Service Delivery and Acceptance Certificate) document OR (iii) (a) Tax Invoice to the extent of the required Pre-Qualification value and (b) Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above referred tax invoice The document submitted as proof of execution must be specifically for the same concerned Purchase Orde r (PO)/Work Order/Contract submitted, clearly indicating the corresponding PO/Work Order/Contract numb er. 2) Average Annual Financial Turnover ending 31st March of financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 sh ould be at least Rs.4.44 Lakhs. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than three years old, the average annual financial turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken i nto account. In this case, the Financial Turnover during last financial year/ the average Financial Turnover during preceding two financial years should be at least Rs.4.44 Lakhs. Bidder shall submit audited Annual reports certified by Chartered Accountant (CA) or Turnover certificates for above financial years. Turnover certificates should be issued by practicing CA with membership numbe r, seal and signed. Certificate / document issued by Chartered Accountant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number. 3) Bidder shall submit PAN details and GST Registration details etc. 4) Ownership of company with name, addresses and telephone nos. of Proprietors/ Partners/ Directors, as t he case may be. 5) Copy of Partnership deed / Proprietorship / Memorandum and Article of Association and Certificate of Inc orporation, as the case may be. The bids shall be uploaded in Single stage 2 (Two) Bid System: Part-I: Pre-qualification documents, if any + Techno-Commercial Bid Part-II: Price Bid

Bids should be submitted as per following instructions only: 1. PART-I: EMD, if any + PREQUALIFICATION DOCUMENTS, if applicable + TECHNO-COMMERCIAL BID, if any should contain following :- ATC/Packet-1: Scanned copy of i) Annexure-IV i.e. ‘Undertaking for No Deviation’ printed on bidders letter head duly signed and stamped b y appropriate authority. ii) Annexure-VI i.e. ‘Tax compliance clauses related to GST’ printed on bidders letter head duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. iii) Annexure-XIIA ‘Model Certificate for Tenders’ printed on bidder letter head duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority [i.e. as per 144(xi) of GFR-2017]. (If any, please submit signed stamped copy of corrigendum’s for subject tender uploaded on GeM portal) iv) Valid MSE certificate etc. v) Annexure-XVIIA i.e. ‘Declaration of Status of Debarment Listing/ Blacklisting/ Holiday Listing duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. vi) Annexure-XVIIB i.e. ‘Undertaking about common Directors/ Partners/ Interest in other associated units/ companies’ duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. ATC/Packet-2: Scanned copy of ‘Work Order copies as per requirement mentioned in Pre-qualification crite ria’. ATC/Packet-3: Scanned copy of “Completion Certificate or documents indicating work completion, as per r equirement mentioned in Pre-qualification criteria". ATC/Packet-4: Scanned copy of “Audited Annual reports certified by Chartered Accountant (CA) OR Turnov er Certificates for last three financial years, as per requirement mentioned in Pre-qualification criteria. ATC/Packet-5: Scanned copy of “Duly filled, signed and stamped copy of the Technical bid / Check list i.e. A nnexure-III” and any other documents, if requested in scope of work, mentioned in tender document. ATC/Packet-6: Scanned copy of “Details of the Company/Ownership with name, address, phone nos. of Pro prietors/Partners/Directors, as the case may be”. ATC/Packet-7: Scanned copy of “Partnership deed / Proprietorship / Memorandum & Article of Association a nd Certificate of Incorporation, as the case may be”. ATC/Packet-8: Scanned copy of “Vendor Data Up-dation form i.e. Annexure-X, along with all the supporting documents, cancelled cheque etc.”. PART-II: PRICED BID:- For tender on GeM portal – Follow GeM guidelines as mentioned in GeM portal. Also submit the price break-up in the format as given with the tender. Bidder have to quote for all items mentioned in the price break-up format. The quoted item wise unit rates must be in whole numbers only, pls. do not quote item wise unit rates in decimal places. Vendor should quote prices as per above only. Offers indicating rates anywhere else (scanned documents etc.) shall be liable for rejection. NOTE: Bidder to note that above tender has been floated on GeM with available it em category i.e. "Goods Transport Service - Per Trip based service" with numbe r of trips as 1 (one). On Gem, bidder shall quote total lump sum amount for all 3 items as mentioned in Price Break-up. Please refer Price Break-up and Scope of Work for actual quantities with units of all 3 individual items. Bidder shall also s ubmit Price Break-up with quoted rates of individual items in format as given wi th tender. Bidder to ensure that the total lump sum amount quoted on GeM shal
l match with total amount quoted in Price Break-up submitted by bidder. .
